label: Assign one role to each user
summary: Prioritizes ADMIN, then CLIENT, when a user has multiple roles

precheck.description: check whether users need a role

execute.description: copy the highest-priority role to each user
execute.sql:
UPDATE "public"."user" u
SET "roleId" = selected_role."roleId"
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (ur."userId")
    ur."userId",
    ur."roleId"
  FROM "public"."userRole" ur
  JOIN "public"."role" r ON r."id" = ur."roleId"
  ORDER BY
    ur."userId",
    CASE r."name"
      WHEN 'ADMIN' THEN 1
      WHEN 'CLIENT' THEN 2
      ELSE 3
    END,
    ur."roleId"
) selected_role
WHERE selected_role."userId" = u."id"
  AND u."roleId" IS NULL

postcheck.description: verify every user has exactly one role
